notes: Settings → Products tab redesigned. Each row is one product family + tier with a utilization bar showing assigned vs available seats. Two purchases of the same product on different days now collapse into ONE row with summed seats and cost, instead of duplicate cards

New 'Ending soon' section appears below the products list when any product is set to cancel. Each row spells out: which product, end date, seat count, monthly cost, AND which managed tenants lose coverage on that date. Undo cancel and Manage in Stripe buttons live next to each entry

Assignment tab now shows expiry indicators from the tenant angle: a top banner counts tenants with ending products, a 'Ending' chip appears next to affected tenant names, and the per-cell pill turns amber with the end date when the assignment uses a cancelling subscription
